text: Empirical evaluation and interpretation. We conduct experiments on M-ABSA, EduRABSA, and an English–Chinese cross-lingual target-domain MOOC benchmark. The target-domain benchmark is therefore described as cross-lingual or bilingual rather than fully multilingual, while the broader training and evaluation setting still includes multilingual ABSA evidence.
source_label: CA-MuSiC: a Culture-Aware Multilingual Skill Cognition Model for MOOC review understanding
